name: w2g-video-adder
description: Chrome and Firefox extension: add YouTube videos to a Watch2Gether room's playlist (or play them now) via right-click, shortcut, or thumbnail buttons.

scripts.lint:firefox: node scripts/build.js firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.start:firefox: node scripts/build.js firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --url https://www.youtube.com
scripts.sign:firefox: node scripts/build.js firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted --artifacts-dir dist
